title: BRING YOUR LITTLE ONES
TO THE SAVIOR
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm wooden kitchen table with open bible and glowing lamp
peaceful countryside home window at twilight with soft light
rustic wooden table with lit candle and vintage bible
quiet rustic living room with warm lamp glow and olive branch
peaceful rural home porch at dusk with gentle glowing light
serene country home interior with warm light on wooden desk
soft warm lamp lighting a vintage family bible on a wooden table

scenes.a: If you are holding a little one tonight and wondering how to guide them, listen.
Lord, we bring our children to You right now, placing them entirely into Your loving care.
And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them,
Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
Father, help us to receive Your kingdom with that same simple, trusting faith.
And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
